text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You there! Our eyes have met, now come 
over here at once! Read this script born 
of my very soul!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I ran into Tanino 
Gimlet holding a completed script.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have already handed a copy to a 
performer of euphoria well-versed in 
theater. Give me your candid thoughts, 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to start, as I've just 
finished reading. ...I felt the heat.
Your burning passion is poured into every
page, 
Gimlet!
choice_data_list: Oh, sounds like a great impression!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To depict a tragic parting—your steadfast 
vision pierced through with sharp clarity.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not overexplaining at the climax and 
daring to end with a concise "Goodbye"
was wonderful too! Simple,
yet deeply piercing 
words.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As for the rest... because your mental 
imagery tends to rush ahead, transitions 
between scenes and character emotions can 
sometimes leap forward abruptly. Perhaps 
unfolding them step by step would improve 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: So it is unpolished!
choice_data_list: Well, you're not used to writing s...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, how do I destroy this current state? 
O wise one, guide me like 
Mephistopheles...!
choice_data_list: Well, you were doing work you aren...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't propose anything quite so 
suspicious. If you'd like,
I can introduce 
you to a wonderful place!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A theater troupe I know is staging a 
performance here, but they seem to be 
short-handed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for you two to help out! You'll 
get to experience the "creator's side" 
that you normally wouldn't see, wouldn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see, a workshop akin to Pygmalion's 
studio, then... Kuku, very well!

text_block_list.name: Actor
text_block_list.text:
Gather round! We're starting blocking 
rehearsal! Let's pick up from where we 
left off this morning!

text_block_list.name: Actors
text_block_list.text:
"I depart on the morrow. Otherwise—" "You 
must not! To think you would be 
banished... Please, let us speak one more 
time..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, even a phantom fairy tale gains 
blood and transforms into everyday 
dialogue once the soul of words resonates 
in this fleeting realm.
...I had failed to perceive it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a great realization! When spoken 
aloud, dialogue gains pacing, warmth... a 
sense of "life," demanding it sound like 
natural conversation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Playwrights also listen to the actors 
speaking the lines and make adjustments 
right on the spot, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Inconceivable...!
So this is how lines are 
polished and refined...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...How could anyone touch the darkness
in 
my soul, a wound so deeply sinful it 
reaches the abyssal underworld?" —Mm, 
perhaps I should break it up here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This large prop... hm,
truly elaborate. An 
actor enters inside to operate the 
mechanisms,
is it? Just like the sovereign 
of iron wings soaring through the vast 
heavens...
choice_data_list: Must have been quite difficult to ...
Must have been quite tough to make.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just as a golem depends upon the 
prowess of its mage, securing the 
materials and fitting sorcery is an 
ordeal. Hence, I cannot incorporate it 
into my script...
choice_data_list: Looks like it'd be tough to make, too.
Looks like it'd be tough to make, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Something on this scale might be 
difficult, but... For instance, you could 
also leave what you want to express to
the 
actors' performances.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To the actors'... performance... For 
example?! What could be summoned, for 
instance?! Could even the gargantuan 
contraption in my script be recreated?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While lending a hand, Tanino Gimlet 
toured backstage with sparkling eyes...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work! The troupe members were 
thrilled too. So... how was it, Gimlet? 
Did you grasp any hints regarding your 
script?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...In this single day, I have attained 
wisdom as though I had secluded myself 
within the School of Athens.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I was forced to realize 
just how utterly unrefined my writing had 
been...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yielding myself to my own impulses, I 
lacked the craft to convey it to the 
audience...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to feel down. In fact, 
realizing that in just one day is amazing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Riiiip!*)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure, Gimlet? Isn't that piece 
full of memories for you?
choice_data_list: You tore up the script and tossed ...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Yet I harbor not a millimeter of 
regret!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For at this very moment, this script has 
been destroyed... and shall be reborn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have learned the method to transmit my 
impulse to the spectators... In other 
words, I have drawn closer to my ideal 
theater!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From the ashes like a phoenix! Stronger! 
As an even more beautiful tale! I shall 
resurrect it again and again!!
choice_data_list: I look forward to seeing how it's ...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Positive? ...Kuku,
nay. I am not driven by 
such things as dreams and hope.
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see its new look!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rather, this is! An impulse reaching 
toward destruction! A trajectory to 
annihilate all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whatever her motive was... her figure 
charging forward with tremendous momentum 
was truly worthy of admiration, I thought.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, do not be so hasty,
thou who seeks to 
witness the tale.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The goal is absolute perfection... which 
means I must pursue the story's ideal. To 
that end, I must partake of the golden 
apples in this theater a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a fearless smirk, Tanino Gimlet 
strode back over to the troupe members. 
Watching her fiery passion, I felt a 
dazzling warmth.
